commit_message: Use manifest sub-asset ID contract during build analysis
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0110 humanoid profiles, portable Humanoid motion, typed Animation Set sources, target-aware resolution, and build/package support.

This request makes build analysis use the asset-manifest stable-ID contract instead of re-deriving generic IDs, so nested HumanoidMotion IDs and targeted motion IDs are validated consistently with manifest loading.
